While industrial production and corporate earnings demonstrate resilience, foreign selling pressures weigh on equities. Upcoming earnings season is crucial as investors assess the impact of input costs on margins. Analysts suggest that the market needs broader economic signals to recover sustainably. Stability in global bond yields and crude oil prices could also influence market sentiment.

title: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank shares rally 7% after Q2 disbursements jump 55% YoY, deposits rise 7%
